angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 715,180 km at 175.88 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.6856 +/- 0.0101 mas (same row, RUWE 0.77): 175.88 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.028 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-908 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract): 715,180 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.95 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-908 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5626 +/- 61 K from Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-908 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hawthorn et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-908 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-908.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.392, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-908 (pscomppars): spectral type G V, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-908: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-908 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.08 dex, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-908 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.03953, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-908 (pscomppars): age 4.6 Gyr, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-908 (pscomppars): rotation period 21.932 d, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-908 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.56 km/s, from Hawthorn et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.3877H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
